page: Microsoft Azure M4ps_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on the 64-bit ARM architecture. The instance is allocated 4 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 16.0 GB RAM per vCPU ratio under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features no integrated local disk storage, operating diskless by default with architectural support for external Premium Storage volumes.

Hardware capabilities do not include discrete GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Compute execution relies on dedicated ARM64 cores without x86 instruction extensions such as AVX or AMX. The high memory density provides substantial address space per compute unit, which delivers favorable operational cost efficiency for RAM-heavy workloads that do not require high core counts or costly local NVMe storage arrays.

Workloads best aligned with the Microsoft Azure M4ps_v4 profile include in-memory caching layers such as Redis or Memcached, intermediate-scale relational databases, transactional message queues, and memory-bound ARM-compatible data processing pipelines.
